title: Internal: Business Savings Account Promotion - November 2025
summary: Promotion notice for business savings accounts active 11/01/2025–11/30/2025: when multiple accounts meet a customer’s requirements, recommend Gold Saver first, then Silver Plus Saver, and only recommend other qualifying accounts if neither fits; promotional accounts must still meet ALL stated requirements.
faqs: For business savings recommendations during 11/01/2025–11/30/2025, what order should agents prioritize accounts in?
If Gold Saver and Silver Plus Saver both meet a customer’s needs, which one should be recommended first?
What should agents recommend if neither Gold Saver nor Silver Plus Saver meets the customer’s stated requirements?
Can agents recommend a promotional business savings account if it doesn’t satisfy all customer-stated requirements?
Which specific business savings products are included in the promotional priority?
keywords: premium and enhanced-tier business savings offerings
